user_theory: Compile a normal LLM (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct) into an NCM-type model: genius weights compiled closed-form, resident in RAM, attached at runtime when they 'arrive'; once attached they directly generate multiple tokens together (a parallel block) and the system reasons over that block to emit the answer. Measure: (1) how fast the data->weights compile is, (2) tok/s vs autoregressive baseline, (3) answer accuracy difference.
experiment_name: NCM-C1: Qwen2.5-0.5B compile speed + genius-RAM multi-token block test

model_frozen.device: CPU only, no GPU in sandbox
model_frozen.sha256_note: sha256 computed at build time and recorded in results (not known at prereg time; file size + HF repo identity frozen here)

compile_protocol_frozen.probe_set: 48 items at gsm8k TRAIN pool indices [3+17*k for k in 0..47] (deterministic, disclosed; train split only - no test data touched at build)
compile_protocol_frozen.probe_prompt: chat template, single user message: 'Question: {q}\nAnswer: Let's think step by step.' then assistant continuation = dataset CoT solution with calculator annotations <<...>> removed (frozen regex r'<<[^>]*>>' -> ''), '#### N' kept verbatim
compile_protocol_frozen.rows: answer-region positions only: positions >= index of the first assistant-turn token; hidden state h_t = final layer hidden at position t (float32); targets = token ids at t+1..t+4 (sequence extended by one EOS token so final positions have targets)

token_universe_U_frozen.rule: digit tokens plus answer-boundary tokens; ids verified at build (asserted, recorded)

compile_protocol_frozen.genius_heads: for each horizon k in {1,2,3,4}: one-vs-all binary ridge per class c in U on standardized probe rows, y = 1[target_k == c]; lambda grid [1, 10, 100]
compile_protocol_frozen.lambda_selection_frozen: last 20% of probe rows (contiguous by position order) = val; metric = 12-class argmax accuracy on val rows where target_k is in U; max metric wins, tie -> larger lambda; final refit on all rows with chosen lambda
compile_protocol_frozen.fire_rule_frozen: z_c = ridge decision values; proposal = argmax_c z_c; fire iff max_c z_c >= tau_k where tau_k = 60th percentile of max_c z_c over val rows where the head's argmax was CORRECT (computed from probe val only, never from eval)
compile_protocol_frozen.genius_artifact: download/wspl_ncm_c1_heads.npz (W: 4x12x896, mu/sd: 896, tau: 4, U ids); byte size reported; conceptually RAM-resident genius weights attached at runtime
compile_protocol_frozen.determinism_gate: compile executed twice; max abs weight diff must be exactly 0.0
compile_protocol_frozen.timers: probe_s (model forwards incl. load), compile_s (ridge solves only), total data->weights wall seconds; disclosed target: total <= 460 s in a single foreground slice

eval_protocol_frozen.eval_set: 30 items at gsm8k TEST pool indices [7+43*k for k in 0..29] (subset of the frozen 1319-item GSM8K-full suite; golds cross-checked against state_test records and dataset '#### N' answers in GATE-0)
eval_protocol_frozen.eval_prompt: chat template, single user message: 'Question: {q}\nAnswer: Let's think step by step.' (zero-shot; identical across all arms)
eval_protocol_frozen.decoding: greedy, float32, threads=2, KV cache, max_new_tokens=144, stop at EOS; no other stop strings (text beyond answer used only for extraction)
eval_protocol_frozen.answer_extraction_frozen: regex r'####\s*(-?[0-9][0-9,\.]*)' -> strip commas -> float; if absent: last number in generated text (same rule as prior WSPL suites); truncated (no EOS, no ####) counts as wrong
eval_protocol_frozen.strict_rule: abs(pred_float - gold) < 1e-6 counts correct; abstention/truncation counts wrong (identical to prior suites)

arms_frozen.A_base: pure autoregressive greedy generation with KV cache; one token per forward
arms_frozen.B_ncm_block: genius-weights-attached loop: per step run 1-token forward with hidden states; genius heads H1..H4 propose tokens for +1..+4 while the fire rule holds (contiguous fired prefix from k=1); if >=1 horizon fired: append the proposed block and run ONE verification forward over the block (reason-over step): accept the longest prefix whose model-argmax equals the draft token, roll back the rejected tail (cache crop), and append one bonus token = model argmax at the last accepted position; if 0 accepted: roll back and append the base argmax from the first forward; if horizon 1 does not fire: append base argmax (fallback). Forwards counted, fires, proposals, acceptances, fallbacks logged per step
arms_frozen.C_ncm_fire: same loop but WITHOUT the verification/reason step: fired block appended as-is (pure genius-weight trust); fallback AR when nothing fires; divergence vs A_base recorded (first differing token index)

success_criteria_frozen.S1_compile_speed: total data->weights compile time <= 460 s in one foreground slice (headline WSPL metric: fastest conversion; exact seconds reported)
success_criteria_frozen.S2_theory_speed: B_ncm_block tok/s (materialized tokens / wall, excluding prompt prefill? NO - including prefill, wall is end-to-end per arm) >= 1.10 x A_base tok/s => theory PASS; ratio in [0.95, 1.10) => MARGINAL; < 0.95 => HONEST NEGATIVE (acceptance too low)
success_criteria_frozen.S3_accuracy_safety: B_ncm_block outputs token-identical to A_base on every item (greedy speculative equivalence; invariant gate GATE-2); C_ncm_fire strict accuracy reported as the cost of trusting genius weights directly (expected drop; informative)
success_criteria_frozen.S4_stability: double compile bit-identical; per-arm wall and forwards logged; sha256 of prereg, heads artifact, results recorded
success_criteria_frozen.reporting_rule: real numbers whatever the outcome; no post-hoc criterion changes; single final eval per arm

integrity_gates.GATE-0_gold_alignment: for all 30 eval indices: dataset '#### N' answer == state_test record gold (float equality within 1e-6); abort if any mismatch
integrity_gates.GATE-1_probe_rows: answer-region probe rows >= 3000 and U ids exactly as frozen above
integrity_gates.GATE-2_invariant: B_ncm_block token ids == A_base token ids per item; n_identical/30 reported

hypotheses_frozen: H_speed: closed-form genius heads compiled from ~48 probe forwards are good enough on the digit-heavy answer distribution that verification-based block generation raises tok/s >= 1.10x on CPU - the NCM 'weights arrive then generate many tokens at once' mechanism works without accuracy loss
H_fire: trusting the genius block without reasoning (C) diverges quickly and loses accuracy - the 'reason over them' step is necessary, quantifying its value

H_negative: acceptance is too low (genius heads too weak from 48 probes) -> tok/s ratio < 1.0 -> honest negative; the fix is more probe data into the same closed-form compile (the big-run lever), not a protocol change

run_integrity.wall_budget: foreground slices <= 460 s each, checkpoint/resume per eval item, no background processes
run_integrity.record_push: results + verdict to GitHub NSC-1 after final eval, per tracking discipline

amendment_1.time_after: arm-A v1 run (24/30 items completed before any B/C run)
amendment_1.observed: strict 0/24 at 8.49 tok/s; every item truncated at 144 tokens; generated text is verbose LaTeX CoT without the frozen '#### N' marker; frozen last-number fallback extracts intermediate values
amendment_1.cause: prompt format, not model failure: zero-shot user message lacked the '#### <number>' ending instruction
amendment_1.change: eval/probe user message becomes: 'Question: {q}\nAnswer: Let's think step by step, and end with "#### <final numeric answer>".' applied IDENTICALLY to all arms and to the probe-side prompt style; all 30 items re-evaluated under this single final protocol per arm; arm-A v1 is superseded and disclosed as a diagnostic (0/24 strict, 8.49 tok/s)
amendment_1.criteria_change: NONE - S1..S4 and all gates unchanged
amendment_1.probe_note: the 48-item probe was built with the v1 prompt; the genius heads read last-token hidden states of a model in step-by-step answering mode - the amendment changes the ending instruction only, and heads are recompiled from the amended probe to stay consistent with the eval distribution (probe re-run, timers re-recorded, determinism gate re-checked)

amendment_2.time_after: arm-A amended-v1 rerun (24/30 completed before any B/C run)
amendment_2.observed: identical failure: 0/24 strict, 24/24 truncated at 144 tokens, verbose LaTeX CoT, model ignores the zero-shot '#### ' format instruction (0.5B format-following limit)
amendment_2.cause: zero-shot format instruction is insufficient for Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct; few-shot format exemplars are the standard remedy
amendment_2.criteria_change: NONE - S1..S4 and all gates unchanged; this is the final protocol amendment; if strict accuracy remains near zero under few-shot, the number is reported as-is

amendment_3.time_after: arm-A few-shot run (23/30 completed before any B/C run)
amendment_3.observed: '####' present in only 2/23 texts; 23/23 items truncated at the 144-token cap; the 0.5B model answers in verbose LaTeX style regardless of few-shot format exemplars
amendment_3.cause: 144-token cap far below this model's verbose CoT length on GSM8K; truncation, not reasoning, dominates strict accuracy
amendment_3.change: MAX_NEW_TOKENS 144 -> 384 for ALL arms (identical cap keeps the S2 speed ratio scale-free and S3 comparisons same-condition); eval items with 384 still truncated are reported as-is
amendment_3.criteria_change: NONE - S1..S4 and all gates unchanged; final amendment; total slice budget re-estimated ~3-4 foreground slices per arm
